# sluglist

> Universal embeddable feedback widget for dev, staging and beta sites. MIT-licensed,
> framework-agnostic, no hosted service: reporters pick an element, screenshot, annotate and
> comment, and the widget delivers a stable set of artifacts (session.yaml + one markdown file per
> issue with YAML frontmatter + PNG screenshots) to pluggable connectors the developer owns.
> Feedback can land in a local folder that a coding agent (e.g. Claude Code) reads and fixes via
> the bundled sluglist-fix skill.

Key facts:
- Install: `npm install sluglist` (ESM + CJS) or a script tag from unpkg.
- One-line setup: `mountFeedbackWidget(createFeedbackWidget({ connectors: [new DownloadConnector()] }))`.
- Capture modes: element (smart CSS selector), area, full page, record-steps (numbered frames), comment-only.
- Local agent loop: `npx sluglist dev` sidecar writes reports to ./.sluglist for an agent to read.
- Checklist mode: pre-seeded acceptance checklist; verdicts form a coverage map in session.yaml.
- Production preset: input masking, screenshot consent, PII text scrubbing, dismiss ✕.
- Zero phone-home: no network requests except to the developer's configured connectors (test-enforced).
- Artifact format is a stable, additively-versioned contract (format_version 1.4).

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://sluglist.dev/docs/quick-start/): install, one-line setup, the three usage scenarios
- [Capture](https://sluglist.dev/docs/capture/): modes, annotation, errors, action trail, form fields, attachments, mobile
- [Connectors](https://sluglist.dev/docs/connectors/): delivery to your own storage — API route, Vercel Blob, S3/R2, Supabase
- [Checklist mode](https://sluglist.dev/docs/checklist/): structured acceptance with a coverage map
- [Production](https://sluglist.dev/docs/production/): presets, PII scrubbing, localization, the production checklist
- [Agents & CLI](https://sluglist.dev/docs/agents/): the local feedback loop and Claude Code skills
- [Artifact format](https://sluglist.dev/docs/artifacts/): the stable contract, field by field

## Use cases

- [Claude Code & coding agents](https://sluglist.dev/for/claude-code/): feedback that fixes itself
- [Client acceptance](https://sluglist.dev/for/client-acceptance/): checklist sign-off on staging
- [Beta & production feedback](https://sluglist.dev/for/beta-feedback/): a privacy-safe "Report a problem" button
